content.headline: Discover Bangladesh,
content.subheadline: Curated domestic tours. Trusted local hosts. Book with an advance and clear the balance on tour day.

content.hero_subheadline: Curated domestic tours. Trusted local hosts. Book with an advance and clear the balance on tour day.
content.destinations_description: Beaches, hill tracts, mangrove forests, and tea country — pick a place, we'll handle the rest.
content.tours_description: Small groups, local hosts, and everything included. Filter by place, duration, or price to find your trip in seconds.
content.why_us_title: Travel with people who call Bangladesh home
content.why_us_description: We're not a booking platform that outsources your trip to strangers. We're local hosts who plan, accompany, and settle every detail — including your final payment, confirmed on both sides.

why_us_items.title: Trusted local hosts
why_us_items.description: Every tour is led by a verified Bangladeshi host who knows their district like family — not a scripted guide.

why_us_items.title: Transparent pricing
why_us_items.description: The price you see is the price you pay. No hidden fees, no last-minute 'fuel surcharges', no surprises.

why_us_items.title: Flexible payment
why_us_items.description: Book with a 40% advance and clear the balance on tour day — online or directly with your host, with confirmation to both sides.

why_us_items.title: Zero-friction booking
why_us_items.description: From browsing to e-ticket in minutes. Your voucher, digital ticket, and reminders arrive automatically on WhatsApp and email.

why_us_items.title: Real 24/7 support
why_us_items.description: A human answers on WhatsApp throughout your trip — not a chatbot that loops you in circles.

why_us_items.title: Money, fully accounted
why_us_items.description: Every payment is tracked end-to-end and confirmed to you and our team, so there's never a dispute about what was paid.

content.services_description: Group or private, family or honeymoon, weekend or expedition — if it's in Bangladesh, we'll host it.

services_items.title: Group Tours
services_items.description: Curated group departures to every corner of Bangladesh, led by a local host and priced all-inclusive.

services_items.title: Private & Custom Trips
services_items.description: Your dates, your pace, your budget. We design a private itinerary around exactly what you want to do.

services_items.title: Honeymoon Packages
services_items.description: Ocean-view suites, candlelit dinners, and private moments — built for two, from arrival flowers to departure.

services_items.title: Family Holidays
services_items.description: Kids-first pacing, safe transport, and hosts who handle the logistics so parents actually relax.

services_items.title: Corporate Retreats
services_items.description: Team trips to the hills or the coast with planning, logistics, and bonding activities handled end to end.

services_items.title: Adventure & Trekking
services_items.description: Hill-tract treks, forest cruises, and off-the-map experiences with certified local guides and permits arranged.

content.offers_title: A little reason to book today
content.offers_description: Seasonal savings and group perks — applied automatically at checkout with the right code.
content.reviews_description: Real words from guests who booked, travelled, and settled their balances — all in one seamless flow.
content.journal_description: Field guides, food trails, and honest travel writing from our hosts and guests.
content.cta_title: Plan your next journey across Bangladesh
content.cta_description: Tell us where you want to go and when — we'll design a tour around you. Book with a small advance and settle the rest on tour day.

content.hero_subtitle: Built by local travelers who believe the best trips happen when you're hosted like family, not processed like a transaction.
content.story_title: Born out of a simple conviction
story_paragraphs: Most domestic travel in Bangladesh was broken in two ways: either you were on your own navigating erratic transport, unverified hotels, and hidden costs — or you were packed into a thirty-person bus tour with fixed buffets and thirty-minute photo stops.
We wanted something different: trips designed the way an experienced friend would show you their hometown. Small groups, handpicked local hosts, honest pricing, and genuine hospitality.

Today, Atithi runs curated journeys to twelve destinations across Bangladesh — from the tea valleys of Sreemangal to the coral reefs of Saint Martin. Every trip is led by someone who actually lives there.
content.mission_text: To make domestic travel across Bangladesh seamless, transparent, and genuinely memorable — while ensuring tourism directly benefits the local communities and guides who make these places special.

values.title: Radical transparency
values.description: No hidden resort fees, surprise fuel charges, or mandatory tips. Every BDT is accounted for upfront.

values.title: Local, always
values.description: No outsourced guides, no foreign templates. Every host is Bangladeshi, and every itinerary is built around real local knowledge.

values.title: Hospitality first
values.description: Atithi — "guest" — is central to Bengali culture. We host you the way we'd host family, not process you like a booking number.

values.title: Considered detail
values.description: From the ridge walk only locals know to the candlelit dinner arranged without being asked — the small things are the trip.

content.booking_description: From your first search to your final confirmed payment, every step is designed to remove friction and ambiguity.
content.team_title: A few of the people who'll host you

team.name: Raisa Chowdhury
team.bio: Ten years guiding across the Chittagong Hill Tracts before building Atithi's tour design team.

team.name: Tanvir Hasan
team.bio: Runs the host network and on-ground logistics across all twelve destinations.

team.name: Mehedi Hasan
team.bio: Built the secure payment and booking system so every advance and balance is tracked without ambiguity.

content.payment_title: How your money is handled, end to end
content.payment_description: Pay in full or pay a small advance through bKash, Nagad, Rocket, or card at booking. If you paid partially, the remaining balance is settled on the day of the tour — either online or in cash directly with your host. The moment it clears, both you and our team get a WhatsApp and email confirmation, so there's a clean record of what was paid, when, on both sides.
content.cta_title: Ready to plan your own story?
content.cta_description: Tell us where you want to go — we'll take it from there, right through to your final confirmed payment.
